stimulus: The Shat Gambuj Mosque is a significant historical structure and was declared a World Heritage Site in (a) -------. The city where the mosque is located was originally known as Khalifatabad and was founded in the 15th century by the Turkish general Ulugh Khan Jahan. The buildings of the city, made of baked (b) -------, show advanced architectural skills and reflect a blend of Mughal and Turkish styles. Among the 360 mosques, the Shat Gambuj Mosque is the most famous. It has 60 pillars and 77 domes, with additional smaller domes on the four (c) -------. The mosque’s vast prayer hall has many arched doorways that allow light and (d) ------- to pass through. The strong and slightly narrowing walls are about six feet (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) 1985; (b) bricks; (c) corners; (d) air; (e) thick; ● st ●
